ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater (MERCURY / Mango Sandstorm) RMM staging — Atera / ScreenConnect / Syncro / RemoteUtilities deployed from Office or browser
ucs.description: Hunts the signature MuddyWater 2022-2025 intrusion chain: spearphishing link to a cloud-hosted MSI/EXE that installs a legitimate Remote Monitoring & Management tool (Atera Agent, ScreenConnect/ConnectWise Control, Syncro, RemoteUtilities, SimpleHelp, AnyDesk) which the operators then drive interactively as their initial foothold and C2. The high-fidelity signal is an RMM installer or agent binary spawned by Outlook, an Office app, a browser, or explorer.exe — a process tree IT-deployed RMM never produces.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","explorer.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("AteraAgent.exe","ateraagent.exe","SimpleHelpCustomer.exe","simplehelpcustomer.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup.exe","SyncroSetup.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","AnyDesk.exe","AnyDeskMSI.exe","SplashtopStreamer.exe","TakeControl.exe") OR (Processes.process_name="msiexec.exe" AND (Processes.process LIKE "%atera%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%Atera%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%simplehelp%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%SimpleHelp%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%screenconnect%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%ScreenConnect%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%connectwisecontrol%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%ConnectWiseControl%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%syncro%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%Syncro%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%remoteutilities%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%RemoteUtilities%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%rutserv%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%AnyDeskMSI%" OR Processes.process LIKE "%anydeskmsi%"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(user,"\$$")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// MuddyWater RMM staging via Office / browser parent — Mandiant/Microsoft (Mango Sandstorm) tracked TTP 2022-2025.
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["atera","ateraagent","simplehelp","simplehelpcustomer","screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","syncro","syncrosetup","remoteutilities","rutserv","rfusclient","anydeskmsi","splashtopstreamer","takecontrol","n-able"]);
let RmmImages = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","simplehelpcustomer.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.clientsetup.exe","syncrosetup.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","anydesk.exe","anydeskmsi.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe"]);
let SuspiciousParents = dynamic(["outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","explorer.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SuspiciousParents)
   or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (SuspiciousParents)
| where FileName in~ (RmmImages)
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens)
   or (FileName =~ "msiexec.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens))
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files\" or FileName !in~ (RmmImages) or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SuspiciousParents)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          GrandParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// MuddyWater RMM staging — Sentinel via SecurityEvent 4688 (or ImProcessCreate).
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["atera","ateraagent","simplehelp","simplehelpcustomer","screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","syncro","syncrosetup","remoteutilities","rutserv","rfusclient","anydeskmsi","splashtopstreamer","takecontrol"]);
let RmmImages = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","simplehelpcustomer.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.clientsetup.exe","syncrosetup.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","anydesk.exe","anydeskmsi.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe"]);
let SuspiciousParents = dynamic(["outlook.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","explorer.exe","7zfm.exe","winrar.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" and TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ParentLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildLeaf  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentLeaf in (SuspiciousParents)
| where ChildLeaf in (RmmImages)
   or tolower(CommandLine) has_any (RmmTokens)
   or (ChildLeaf == "msiexec.exe" and tolower(CommandLine) has_any (RmmTokens))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater RMM Staging - Office/Browser Spawning Atera/ScreenConnect/Syncro/RemoteUtilities
id: 9b6c8d2a-1f4c-4f0c-9b14-b1d3b2c6a201
status: experimental
description: Detects MuddyWater (MERCURY / Mango Sandstorm / Static Kitten) initial-access pattern of dropping a legitimate Remote Monitoring & Management agent (Atera, ScreenConnect, Syncro, RemoteUtilities, SimpleHelp, AnyDesk) from a phishing-driven parent (Outlook, Office apps, browser, archive viewer).
references:
    - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/04/12/tarrask-malware-uses-scheduled-tasks-for-defense-evasion/
    - https://www.deepinstinct.com/blog/muddywater-eternal-rmm
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.command-and-control
    - attack.t1566.002
    - attack.t1204.002
    - attack.t1219.002
    - attack.g0069
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    parent_phish:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\outlook.exe'
            - '\winword.exe'
            - '\excel.exe'
            - '\powerpnt.exe'
            - '\chrome.exe'
            - '\msedge.exe'
            - '\firefox.exe'
            - '\brave.exe'
            - '\explorer.exe'
            - '\7zfm.exe'
            - '\winrar.exe'
    rmm_image:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\AteraAgent.exe'
            - '\SimpleHelpCustomer.exe'
            - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
            - '\ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup.exe'
            - '\SyncroSetup.exe'
            - '\rutserv.exe'
            - '\rfusclient.exe'
            - '\AnyDesk.exe'
            - '\AnyDeskMSI.exe'
            - '\SplashtopStreamer.exe'
    rmm_cmdline:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'AteraAgent'
            - 'SimpleHelp'
            - 'ScreenConnect'
            - 'ConnectWiseControl'
            - 'SyncroSetup'
            - 'RemoteUtilities'
            - 'rutserv'
            - 'AnyDeskMSI'
            - 'SplashtopStreamer'
    condition: parent_phish and (rmm_image or rmm_cmdline)
falsepositives:
    - IT helpdesk pushing RMM packages via legitimate, documented deployment channels
    - User self-installing AnyDesk/Atera for sanctioned support session
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @ParentImage:(*\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\winword.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\powerpnt.exe OR *\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\explorer.exe OR *\7zFM.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe) (@Image:(*\AteraAgent.exe OR *\ateraagent.exe OR *\SimpleHelpCustomer.exe OR *\simplehelpcustomer.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\ConnectWiseControl.ClientSetup.exe OR *\SyncroSetup.exe OR *\rutserv.exe OR *\rfusclient.exe OR *\AnyDesk.exe OR *\AnyDeskMSI.exe OR *\SplashtopStreamer.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*AteraAgent* OR *ateraagent* OR *SimpleHelp* OR *simplehelp* OR *ScreenConnect* OR *screenconnect* OR *ConnectWiseControl* OR *connectwisecontrol* OR *Syncro* OR *syncro* OR *RemoteUtilities* OR *remoteutilities* OR *rutserv* OR *AnyDeskMSI* OR *anydeskmsi* OR *SplashtopStreamer*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(outlook|winword|excel|powerpnt|chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|explorer|7zfm|winrar)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(AteraAgent|SimpleHelpCustomer|ScreenConnect\.WindowsClient|ConnectWiseControl\.ClientSetup|SyncroSetup|rutserv|rfusclient|AnyDesk|AnyDeskMSI|SplashtopStreamer)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/(AteraAgent|SimpleHelp|ScreenConnect|ConnectWiseControl|Syncro|RemoteUtilities|rutserv|AnyDeskMSI|SplashtopStreamer)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=([count(), min(@timestamp), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData])]))
| _count > 0
ucs.rationale: Mandiant, Microsoft Threat Intelligence (Mango Sandstorm), Deep Instinct and CISA AA22-055A all flag the *combination* of (a) spearphishing link delivery and (b) drop-and-run of legitimate RMM tooling as MuddyWater's defining intrusion chain since 2022 — distinct from APT34/APT35 which favour custom backdoors. Parent-process scoping eliminates legitimate IT-pushed RMM (msiexec spawned by services.

ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater PowGoop loader — GoogleUpdate.exe side-loading goopdate.dll / libpcre-1.dll from a non-Google directory
ucs.description: Detects the PowGoop loader, Mandiant-attributed to MuddyWater (MERCURY / Seedworm) and used as the foothold for the POWERSTATS / Small Sieve PowerShell backdoor. The actor stages a legitimate, signed Google Update binary (GoogleUpdate.exe) in a writable directory and side-loads a malicious goopdate.dll alongside it, decrypting a config.txt payload to run PowerShell C2. Any GoogleUpdate.exe image load of goopdate.dll outside %ProgramFiles%\Google\ is high-fidelity MuddyWater tradecraft.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.process_name) as writers values(Filesystem.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("goopdate.dll","goopdate64.dll","libpcre-1.dll","Goopdate.dat","config.txt") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| where NOT (file_path LIKE "%\\Program Files\\Google\\%" OR file_path LIKE "%\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\%")
| join type=inner dest [
    | tstats summariesonly=true values(Processes.process) as ggupdate_cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as ggupdate_parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="GoogleUpdate.exe" by Processes.dest Processes.process_path
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
    | where NOT (process_path LIKE "%\\Program Files\\Google\\%" OR process_path LIKE "%\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\%")]
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// MuddyWater PowGoop — GoogleUpdate.exe side-load of goopdate.dll / libpcre-1.dll outside the legit Google install path.
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "googleupdate.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("goopdate.dll","goopdate64.dll","libpcre-1.dll")
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files\Google\"
   and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          LoadedDll        = FileName,
          LoadedFrom       = FolderPath,
          DllSHA256        = SHA256,
          GoogleUpdatePath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          GoogleUpdateCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          Account          = InitiatingProcessAccountName
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName in~ ("goopdate.dll","goopdate64.dll","libpcre-1.dll","Goopdate.dat","config.txt")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, DroppedBy = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DroppedCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, FileName
) on DeviceName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// MuddyWater PowGoop loader — Sentinel via Sysmon EventID 7 (image load).
Event
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Source =~ "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 7
| extend ImageLoaded = tostring(extract(@"ImageLoaded\">([^<]+)<", 1, EventData))
| extend Image       = tostring(extract(@"<Data Name=\"Image\">([^<]+)<", 1, EventData))
| extend Signed      = tostring(extract(@"Signed\">([^<]+)<", 1, EventData))
| where tolower(Image) endswith "\\googleupdate.exe"
| where tolower(ImageLoaded) endswith "\\goopdate.dll"
    or tolower(ImageLoaded) endswith "\\goopdate64.dll"
    or tolower(ImageLoaded) endswith "\\libpcre-1.dll"
| where not (tolower(ImageLoaded) contains "\\program files\\google\\"
          or tolower(ImageLoaded) contains "\\program files (x86)\\google\\")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, ImageLoaded, Signed
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater PowGoop Loader - GoogleUpdate.exe Side-Loading Malicious goopdate.dll
id: 4a1b9f3e-7d2c-49b1-a6b9-1d5e8c0d4ab2
status: experimental
description: Detects the PowGoop loader used by MuddyWater (MERCURY / Mango Sandstorm / Seedworm). A signed GoogleUpdate.exe binary loads goopdate.dll / goopdate64.dll / libpcre-1.dll from a directory outside the legitimate Google install path, then decrypts a Goopdate.dat / config.txt payload to launch the POWERSTATS PowerShell backdoor.
references:
    - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/powgoop-mandiant-mercury-iran
    - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/04/12/tarrask-malware-uses-scheduled-tasks-for-defense-evasion/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.defense-evasion
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1574.001
    - attack.t1574.002
    - attack.t1140
    - attack.g0069
logsource:
    category: image_load
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
        ImageLoaded|endswith:
            - '\goopdate.dll'
            - '\goopdate64.dll'
            - '\libpcre-1.dll'
    filter_legit_path:
        ImageLoaded|contains:
            - '\Program Files\Google\'
            - '\Program Files (x86)\Google\'
    condition: selection and not filter_legit_path
falsepositives:
    - Google Update binary executed from a custom enterprise install path (uncommon — verify the DLL is Google-signed)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:7 @Image:(*\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\googleupdate.exe OR *\GOOGLEUPDATE.EXE) @ImageLoaded:(*\goopdate.dll OR *\Goopdate.dll OR *\GOOPDATE.DLL OR *\goopdate64.dll OR *\Goopdate64.dll OR *\libpcre-1.dll OR *\Libpcre-1.dll) -@ImageLoaded:(*\Program?Files\Google\* OR *\Program?Files?\(x86\)\Google\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\\(goopdate(64)?\.dll|libpcre-1\.dll|Goopdate\.dat|config\.txt)$/i
| NOT TargetFileName=/\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\Google\\/i
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\GoogleUpdate\.exe$/i | NOT ImageFileName=/\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\Google\\/i}, field=aid, include=[ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ImageFileName], function=([count(), min(@timestamp), collect([CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])]))
ucs.rationale: PowGoop is the Mandiant-/Microsoft-/ClearSky-named loader exclusively attributed to MuddyWater (G0069 / MERCURY / Mango Sandstorm). The DLL side-load triplet (GoogleUpdate.exe + goopdate.dll + libpcre-1.dll + Goopdate.dat / config.txt) is documented as the loader's exact disk layout, with goopdate.dll being malicious and replacing the legitimate Google component. No other tracked APT or commodity
